verify.note: The default runs no hook, so the replay proves Enhanced: at every hook every register with R, all 48K RAM bar the sites and the dead stack, the clock, the MMU and the game's ports in order against the original; tiles, characters, digits, redraws and scroll columns against the set, and each update's picture against the ULA; ABI cases on f6's states and 12 broken builds, one of them the interrupt wrapper leaving another register selected. Pace, soak, flicker and the real loader are in games/into_the_eagles_nest.md "Evidence".

status.title: Into the Eagle's Nest
status.build: v1.0; into_the_eagles_nest_loading.nex 2a73be32 and into_the_eagles_nest_enhanced_loading.nex 6a224cab equal the published .nxc 1.0 bare builds, default and Enhanced (without the screen b7d029c5, 9b32aa8d); default: the original game, start-up fixes only, no clash to remove and none claimed; Enhanced, off by default: the Spec256 set's tiles and text on Layer 2 moved by its offsets, the panel as sprites; top bank 47, fits a 1MB Next
status.software: 6 recordings, 39,171 frames (c1 to frame 6,000), 629,351 hooks with R and 48K RAM, the game's ports in order; 492,921 tiles, 3,614 characters, 78,285 digits, 576 scroll columns and 3,757,248 cells against the ULA; 896 ABI cases, 12 of 12 broken builds, one the interrupt wrapper leaving another register selected; ROM paths complete; review run: Enhanced pace in JNext in lockstep, whole runs -2.78% to -0.00% (faster only where the original lags), slowest 20 updates at most +0.38%; 15-minute soaks, flicker, real loader on private cards; Enhanced's WELCOME box is missing
